maharana-institute-of-professional-studi.description: Maharana Institute of Professional Studies is a private engineering college of the Maharana Pratap Group of Institutions, on the group's Bithoor campus near Kanpur.
maharana-institute-of-professional-studi.about: The institute was founded in 2008 and sits on a 25-acre campus at Bithoor. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow (code 349). It offers B.Tech in several branches.
maharana-institute-of-professional-studi.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

maharana-pratap-engineering-college.description: Maharana Pratap Engineering College is a private engineering college of the Maharana Pratap Group of Institutions, launched in 1999 as the first private engineering college in Kanpur.
maharana-pratap-engineering-college.about: The college started in 1999. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow (code 046). The group's Mandhana campus is on NH-91, about 3 km from IIT Kanpur.
maharana-pratap-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

naraina-college-of-engineerring-and-tech.description: Naraina College of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college at Ratanpur, Panki, Kanpur, affiliated to AKTU.
naraina-college-of-engineerring-and-tech.about: The college belongs to the Naraina Group of Institutions, established in 2007 at Ratanpur and Gangaganj in Panki, Kanpur. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. It offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, MCA and polytechnic programmes.
naraina-college-of-engineerring-and-tech.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

national-sugar-institute.description: The National Sugar Institute is a Government of India institute for sugar technology on GT Road at Kalyanpur, Kanpur.
national-sugar-institute.about: The Government of India set it up in October 1936 as the Imperial Institute of Sugar Technology. It became the Indian Institute of Sugar Technology after 1947 and was renamed the National Sugar Institute in April 1957. It moved to its own 524-acre campus at Kalyanpur in 1963.
national-sugar-institute.address: GT Road Kalyanpur, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India 208017

psit-pranveer-singh-institute-of-technol.description: Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology is a private engineering college on the Kanpur-Agra-Delhi highway at Bhauti, Kanpur, with a NAAC A+ grade.
psit-pranveer-singh-institute-of-technol.about: PSIT was established in 2004. It holds a NAAC A+ grade and has NBA-accredited programmes. It admits B.Tech students through UPTAC counselling and is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow.
psit-pranveer-singh-institute-of-technol.address: Kanpur - Agra - Delhi National Highway (NH-19), Bhauti-Kanpur-209305
psit-pranveer-singh-institute-of-technol.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

uttar-pradesh-textile-technology-institu.description: Uttar Pradesh Textile Technology Institute, formerly the Government Central Textile Institute, is a textile engineering institute at Souterganj, Kanpur.
uttar-pradesh-textile-technology-institu.about: The institute began in 1914. In 1937 it took its present form as the Government Central Textile Institute by merging textile institutes at Kanpur and Roorkee. It was affiliated first to Agra University and then to Kanpur University, and its B.Tech programmes are now under Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow.
uttar-pradesh-textile-technology-institu.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

vision-institute-of-technology.description: Vision Institute of Technology is a private engineering college at Hathipur, off NH-2 near Kanpur, affiliated to AKTU.
vision-institute-of-technology.about: The institute was established in 2009 and has a 15-acre campus. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow (code 523) and approved by AICTE for B.Tech, B.Tech (Agriculture) and polytechnic programmes. Its polytechnic is affiliated to the Board of Technical Education, Lucknow.
vision-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

dr-rizvi-college-of-engineering.description: Dr. Rizvi College of Engineering is a private engineering college at Karari in Kaushambi district, affiliated to AKTU.
dr-rizvi-college-of-engineering.about: The college is part of the Rizvi group of institutions at Karari. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It offers B.Tech in computer science, mechanical, civil, electrical and electronics, and electronics and communication engineering, along with MBA and polytechnic courses.
dr-rizvi-college-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

madhu-vachaspati-institute-of-engieneeri.description: Madhu Vachaspati Institute of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college on G.T. Road in Kaushambi district, affiliated to AKTU.
madhu-vachaspati-institute-of-engieneeri.about: The institute is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow (formerly UPTU) and approved by AICTE. It offers B.Tech (AKTU code 467) and MBA (code 749). It is located at Rasoolabad on G.T. Road, Kaushambi.
madhu-vachaspati-institute-of-engieneeri.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

ambalika-institute-of-management-and-tec.description: Ambalika Institute of Management and Technology is a private engineering and management college on Maurawan Road, Mohanlalganj, Lucknow, affiliated to AKTU.
ambalika-institute-of-management-and-tec.about: AIMT was established in 2008. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and the Board of Technical Education, and approved by AICTE. Its computer science and mechanical engineering programmes are accredited by NBA.
ambalika-institute-of-management-and-tec.address: Maurawan Road, Mohanlalganj, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226301
ambalika-institute-of-management-and-tec.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
